newsitem.title: JORDAN: Egypt's Mubarak to hold talks with King Hussein.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Mubarak to hold talks with King Hussein.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak will brief King Hussein on Tuesday on the latest Middle East peace developments during a stopover at Amman airport on his way back to Cairo after talks in Damascus, officials said.

They said King Hussein would hold talks at Amman's international airport with Mubarak, who was expected later in the day from Damascus where he opened previously unannounced talks with Syrian President Hafez al-Assad.
Earlier in the day Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy held talks in Amman with his Jordanian opposite number Fayez al-Tarawnah.

Tuesday's diplomatic activity comes a day after Israel put the brakes on a plan to build a new Jewish enclave in Arab East Jerusalem and agreed to resume talks with the PLO on meeting commitments made under their interim peace deals.
